name: Beach morningglory
desc: Beach Morning-Glory (Ipomoea imperati): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 77 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ipomoea imperati, the beach morning-glory, is a species of flowering plant in the family Convolvulaceae. Like Ipomoea pes-caprae, its seeds disperse by floating in seawater.
